metadata.source_resolution: Approximately 25 km; displayed at the export grid resolution
metadata.observed_period: 1991–2020 (declared by the baseline export script; provenance unverified)
metadata.method: Future frequency = observed reference + (model future − model historical), clamped to [0,366]; run shared existing hazard/risk functions per hex.
assumptions: Frequency-only scenario: fixed severity weather from the existing engine (50mm rain; 44°C and 3 heat days) is retained.
Terrain, population, sensitivity, adaptive capacity and pollution context held at current input values.
Heat frequency uses >40°C; the existing severity formula retains altitude/coastal thresholds. No local heatwave-duration projection is inferred.
Model and observed reference periods differ; threshold/export provenance and bias correction require scientific review.
Only dry heat and pluvial-flood screening risk are dynamically calculated. Rainfall-threshold days do not predict inundation or river/flash flood.
Other hazard scores are current context only; no future composite over unmodelled channels is reported.
Risk may plateau when existing occurrence/duration factors saturate. Inspect changed days and factors alongside risk.
No future population, casualties, service failures or numeric technology benefit is inferred.
